description: agy-readable: hide Claude's answer while it streams, then show it rewritten into plainer Korean by agy (Antigravity CLI). If agy is slow or fails, the original answer is shown with a one-line note. When agy is not signed in, it offers the Google sign-in and takes the code pasted into the prompt.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run"; [ -f "$f" ] || { cat >/dev/null; exit 0; }; sh "$f" prompt; exit 0
